يستنجبوا (form X)
# يَسْتَنْجِبُوا (yastanjibū) /jas.tan.d͡ʒi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# يُسْتَنْجَبُوا (yustanjabū) /jus.tan.d͡ʒa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
